147)༄༅/nyang gter bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sgrub chen 'don 'grigs bde chen dgyes pa'i lang tsho bzhugs/148)༄༅/na mo shrī badz+ra dhā ra ye/bad

tei:div.tei:p: 147) ༄༅/ nyang gter bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sgrub chen 'don 'grigs bde chen dgyes pa'i lang tsho bzhugs/ 148)༄༅/ na mo shrī badz+ra dhā ra ye/ bde chen ye shes klong dgu'i sgyu 'phrul gar// he ru ka dpal tshom bu dgu yi lhar// gnyis med mnyam brdal ngang du rab btud nas// sgrub chen 'don 'grigs skal bzang dga' byed spel//

dpal bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho zhes paṇa grub yongs kyi thugs kyi thig le bka' gter chu bo brgya phrag 'dus pa gter kha gong ma'i lugs 'di la'ang*/ bka' babs dang po mkha' klong yangs pa'i bsgrigs chog dang*/ bar pa zhig po gling pa dang*/ tha ma gter bdag gling pa'i ljags bsgrigs te gsum du bzhugs pa las/ 'dir yig cha 'byor ba dang bstun la las byang mkha' klong lugs ltar btang na mchan bus gsal ba ltar yin/ zhig gling lugs la/ sgrub khog dang dbang chog bka' brgyad chen po'i yig cha ltar btang ba la/ thog mar sna sel/ mgron bzhi mchod pa/ tsha tsha gdab pa/ nye'u 'don pa/ khrus bya ba/ na raka dong sprugs/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg tshogs dang skong gsol rnams dang*/ bka' brgyad dam phur pa gang rung gi gtor zlog mdos glud gang 'grub/ gnas kyi shar du sher phyin/ lhor stobs po che/ nub tu lang gshegs/ byang du tog gzungs 'don pa 149) rnams bya/ ༈ sa chog ni/ hrī:sngon= brgyud 'debs/ rin snam rgyun khyer ram/ chags med/ skyabs sems dang*/ rang nyid kun bzang 'od du= gang bde/ bzlas pa mthar/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ gis bsdus/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ lhar ldang ngo*/ sgrub khog gi sa lha/ oṃ badz+ra= nas/ sa ma ya dzaḥ hūm̐ don dam= 'od du zhu ba las/ zab don nang*/ lha rdzas las grub pa'i= shab+da= bcas/ gtsang zhing= tshigs bcad sngags rnams kha phral/ gtor ma gsum po byin rlabs re re bzhin bya/ khro bcu sngags bcas/ sa sbyang ba/ dbang du bya ba/ byin gyis rlob pa/ gsal bar gyur/ bar/ slob dpon dbus su/ mched lcam rnams phyogs bzhir 'khod nas/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe= shab+da sarba pañtsa rak+ta bha ling+ta khā hi/ zhes phyi nang gi mchod pa dang*/ shar nas/ e ma ho= sogs byang pas tshar nas slob ma rnams rang gral 'khod/ sa bzung ba/ gha gha gha ta ya= khro bcu'i phur gdab/ mi gnas par gyur/ ༈ rgyal tho 'dzugs pa ni/ ser sbreng gi shar du/ zab don/ mchod rlabs/ sa chog gter ma byin rlabs bya ba'am/

yang na/ thams cad stong nyid= sogs mchod rlabs dang*/ gtor gzhong rat+na'i= sogs gtor ma byin 150) rlabs spyi 'gro btang*/ bdag nyid dpal phyag na= sogs bsdus pa de bskyur la/ rgyas pa/ hūm̐:ri rab chen po'i= badz+ra ye swa hā/ bar/ bkra shis shwa lo ka re rjod/ mchod gtor byin rlabs nas phyogs gzhan de'i 'gros/ dam sri mnan pa ni/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud= gser skyems mthar/ ya ma dam sri= bcug par gyur/ bar/ spyi skul/ dur khrod rab 'jigs= 'gugs pa spyi 'gro/ a mṛ ta= sogs/ phur gdab/ bro ra bskor nas/ las bzhi'i bro/ ma ṭam sgrol skabs byung ba 'dir blang*/ sgo byang ni/ gshin rje chos kyi= mchod gtor byin rlabs gong ltar/ mnan par gyur/ sgo byang dang phur pa sgo them btags*/ ling ga la 'gugs gzhug bsdus pa dang*/ phur pas gdab/ ya them gyi= gyur/ gong gi sgo 'di yan chad su yang ma 'da' zhig rjod/ ma traṃ sgrol ba ni/ gtong thun bshad/ shes par bya/ gnyis pa rtags cho gas 'dul ba'i las rim la 'jug par zhu/ bdag nyid skad cig gis= bkug par gyur: bar/ spyi 'gugs/ sgrub pa zab mo= sbyar ba gsum/ gong gi hūm̐:ma traṃ bya ba'i= tshul du mnan: 'og gi oṃ ma hā= gnyis su med par gyur/ las bzhi'i bro rdung*/ tshud par gyur/ bgegs rig stong phrag= ༈ khro bcu la/ 151) 'og gi skyed chog yar blang ba'am/ 'dir dor nas rgyan bkod skabs btang yang chog rang nyid kyi= bzhugs par gyur/ las mkha' klong yangs pa'i byang gi hūm̐: bdag nyid las kyi= khro bcu skabs phur pa so sor 'khod/ hūm̐: ye nas rnam dag= sa ma ya a ti: bar btang*/ ༈ chag chag gdab pa ni/ bdud rtsi byin rlabs las byang ltar/ hūm̐: bdud rtsi dri chen= ghaṇ+ḍe maṇ+ḍal hūm̐: 'bring po dang bsdus pa bskyur/ ༈ dam tshig thig le las/ bdag nyid las kyi che mchog= rang bzhin du gyur: ༈ lha sta gon ni/ rang nyid che mchog zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur gyur: tshom bu bkod cing*/

lha sngags rgyas pa'am/ gtso dgu bka' sdod dang bcas pa'i sngags rjod/ rang gi thugs ka nas= byon par gyur: bar/ zab don gyi mchod pa byin rlabs/ ting 'dzin rnam gsum nas/ bstod pa/ bskul pa/ bshags pa/ dzab dgongs/ bskyed rdzogs chung ngu'i las byang gter gzhung gi gzhung bstod nas ma tshang ba thams cad zab don las blang*/ snyen bstod/ dregs gsol/ tshogs/ lhag ma yan/ sgrub khog gi gsol gdab/ hūm̐: dkyil 'khor= steng gi bar snang la bzhugs par gyur: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ= shab+da rū pa= 152) sarba pañtsa rak+ta ba liṃ ta khā hi: hūm̐:bde gshegs thams cad mnyam nyid= sho lo kas bstod/ ༈ slob dpon s+t+wa gon ni/ mkha' khyab kyi rtsa gsum/ me tog dam pa= sho lo ka lta bus mchod/ dbang gi mdo byang las/ ji srid 'khor ba= bdag gis bkod: bar/ sa gzhi spos chus= maṇ+ḍal dang*/ zab don gyi/ hūm̐: rmad du byung ba'i= gtor ma 'bul/ brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs chen mo gter gzhung dang*/ yan lag bdun pa/ slob ma sta gon nang*/ ho: zhi ba'i lha tshogs= bdag gsol 'debs: bar/ ༈ bum pa sta gon ni/ dbang gi mdo byang*/ hūm̐ las khro chung= bskrad par gyur: sum+bha ni= sgrub khog 'og gi bum rdzas sngags/ oṃ bu pa ka ri= gzungs thag sngags yan 'dir blang*/ bskyed chog badz+ra a mri ta= he ru ka= bar mngon rtogs 'bring po sbyar na/ dbu dgu= yab dang mthun par bskyed: de'i 'gros sgrub khog gzhung gsal gtso skyed rgyas pa dang*/ 'khor skyed bsdus pa gzhung gsal/ sna tshogs dang bcas par gyur: bum pa gnyis skyed 'dor/ las kyi bum par= hūm̐: sngon po= mngon rtogs/ dbu'i gnas= byon par gyur: zab don spyan 'dren nas/ bstod bshags bar/ sgrub khog gi 153) rang gi snying ga'i= dbyer med par gyur: 'og gi sngags/ bho dhi= sogs/ ye shes lha tshogs lta bus bstod/ lha rnams= 'dres par gyur/ ༈ slob ma sta gon ni/ khrus bya/ bgegs bskrad/ mtshams bcad zin nas/

maṇ+ḍal so bdun ma/ zhi khro bshags chung*/ ye shes sku mchog yig brgya bdun tsam bzla/ sgrub khog gi'o/ sems can= brgyud rim 'phro mthud/ dbang gi mdo byang las/ gsang ba spyi rgyud= tshig par gyur/ yungs dkar 'thor/ ging 'cham dang sbrags dbyangs rol bcas/ hūm̐: yang dag gsang ba'i= bgegs bskrad/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi/ rdzas byin rlabs/ yid la byed bzhin nyol cig: dge bsngo bya/ slob ma grol/ ༈ ye thig gdab pa ni/ gong gi las thig skabs kyi dmigs pa/ bdag nyid las kyi che mchog= mtshan par gyur: ye thig gi rigs lnga yab yum= bh+rum̐ dzñā na maṇ+ḍal swa hā: thig skor bya/ oṃ badz+ra be ga kra ma ho: hi zhes sgo bzhi po phye bar gyur: ༈ tshon byin rlabs ni/ a mṛ ta= 'od phung chen por gyur: rjes chog gzhan bya srol med gsung yang*/ bskul chad brtan bro 154) rjes chog sogs byas kyang chog go snyam/ tshogs grol/ rdul tshon bkye/ sgrub gtor bca' ba rnams bya'o/ sgrub chen dbang du mi 'brel skabs/ lha/ slob dpon/ bum pa/ slob ma sta gon bzhi po skyur chog ༈ phyir nyin rgyan bkod la/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa/ bsdu ldang bcas/ sgrub khog gi hūm̐: 'phrul bzhad= bdag las kyi= bting bar gyur: gong gi gsang mtshams khro bcu skabs kyi skyed chog a mṛ ta= khro bcu'i sngags bcas 'dir blang*/ hūm̐: tshangs la dbang= phyi mchod bkod pa'i bar/ byin rlabs las byang gi hūm̐: spos dang= tshe yu bh+rum̐ hūm̐: bar/ gtong thun bcas/ mnga' gsol/ gtong thun bcas rtags 'bul ba/ lan gdab/ slob mar rtags gdab/ taṃ bha si ho: zhes pa da lta'i dpe rgyun las 'dug las byang gi brda sgo/ brda phyag sgrub khog gi mkhyen gsol/ sman bsdu ba= sogs nas/ bsrung bar gyur: bsre bsnan ni/ slob dpon gyis/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal= sman mchod/ yungs thun 'thor/ dam chu sbyin/ las bum gyi khrus bya/ bgegs bskrad/ spro bskyed/ sdig bshags/ skyabs sems/ byin brlab/

smon lam 155) me tog/ mig dar bkye bsdu/ slar dam chu sbyin/ phreng ba byin brlab/ gtang rag btang*/ thams cad kyis/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐: rdo rje gsor/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe hūm̐: dril bu dkrol la dkur brten/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā ba at+ma ko3 haṃ: thugs dkar bsnol/ rtsa ba sku gsung thugs= 'tsho bar gnang: dpal dgu'i sngags brjod pas rten phur rnams byug bdug brab/ rten de dag= ldan par gyur: bdag nyid= sogs tshigs bcad 'di rnams dbyangs dang lhug 'don gang mos bya/ dpal dgu/ bka' sdod bcas rdzogs nas/ de yan chad sngon 'gro'i bya ba'o/ dngos gzhi ni/ hrīḥsngon= mchod pa byin brlab/ spos phyung*/ gsol 'debs gang rung*/ las byang gi skyabs sems/ yan bdun bcas lan gsum/ de mtshams cha gsum btang na/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa= mchis par mdzod: spyan drangs gdan 'bul 'dir blang*/ oṃ in+d+ra= sogs dang po dang*/ gnyis pa/ ar+ghaṃ swa hā/ 'gres/ shab+da/ bar/ hūm̐/ 'byung po= mchod sbyin gtor ma= gong ltar/ ya hi= sogs gsum pa/ bigh+nan swa hā/ 156) saṃ bha ra= ar+ghaṃ swa hā= shab+da'i bar/ hūm̐ gang zhig= chos la spyod par shog mtshan mas lha skyed pa/ oṃ ma hā shu ne ta= hūm̐: phyogs bcu= sogs/ bstod pa/ bshags pa'i skabs/ ye shes sku mchog= btang*/ lha bskyed skabs bskyed rdzogs rgyas pa skyed/ 'bring po dor/ mchod pa rdzogs nas/ 'og gi bstod pa/ hūm̐: ma bcos= bstod pa bsdus pa dor/ 'og gi bshags pa bcas/ skabs 'di tsam du sgrub khog gi dzab bskul 'og 'khor la bka' bsgo'i gtong thun bshad/ sgrub khog gi dzab dmigs/ gzhal yas khang gi lha'i gnas su= ma yengs par bya/ bar dbang gi mdo byang*/ nub dang po/ sdig pa sbyong dmigs/ sngags bkod dor/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer dmar po= dag par gyur/ sgrub khog gi dzab bskul/ hūm̐:gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor= mtshams su bho dhi bdun re/

mthar bho dhi sum brgya/ ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs= sogs stong tshig mchod bstod/ 'og ma thams cad la'ang 'gre/ 'di mtshams rtsa rgyud las gsungs pa'i khro bo'i spyi sngags snga rabs pas btang snyoms mdzad pa bzla na/ zab don gyi/ hūm̐: pho brang dgu rdzogs= mi btong ngo: oṃ 157)badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭan ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa: sum brgya tsam/ stong tshig sgrub khog gi che mchog nas rim par btang*/ che mchog la stong phrag gcig dpal brgyad so sor brgya rtsa re/ bka' sdod dzab skul med par bzlas pa sum cu/ stong tshig bcas/ drag sngags so lnga thun ma 'khor bar bzla/ gzhung srong pas/ thun mthar tshe dzab/ oṃ bh+rum̐ badz+ra= brgya re bzla/ stong tshig bcas/ lhan cig tu nyul le bskrad pa dang byin 'bebs rnying ma spyi lugs la nub mo bkra shis mthar yin yang*/ rang lugs ltar nyin gzhung btang na/ e yaṃ dz+wa la raṃ: brub khung yangs shing gting zab pa'i nang du tri las dngos grub la bar du gcod cing log par 'dren pa'i 'byung po nyams len bdud kyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad rid cing nyam thag pa'i lus can du gyur: spyi 'gugs la/ dngos grub la= gong ltar/ thams cad mtshan ma rdzas kyi rten 'di la mchis par gyur cig: tri yaṃ dza tri badz+ra aṅku sha dza: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho: ces bkug la/ hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings= phur thun mtshan bskul dang*/ drag sngags so lnga dbyangs bcas thun gdab/ sgrub khog gi hūm̐: shar phyogs dkar mo= 158) phaṭa: bar/ 'dir rat+na'i rig 'dzin byin 'bebs/ bka' brgyad kyi dur khrod byin 'bebs btang*/ gzhung chen dzab la 'jug gzhung bsro pas/ thun gnyis pa zab don/ rda sgo dbye ba nas dzab bskul/ bka' srung bsnyen pa yan rang gzhung*/ drag sngags so lngas thun gzung*/ thun mthar sgrub khog gi tshe dzab brgya/ ye shes lha tshogs= stong tshig bya/ thun gsum pa/ brda sgo nas/ drag sngags so lngas thun gzung yan grub nas/

lhan gcig tu zhi ba'i tshe sgrub tshe lung*/ bdun pa/ tshe bum bh+rum̐ las= 'og ma nas/ tshe bum la thim par gyur: tshe bh+rum̐= bsnyen/ dkyil 'khor= mtha' dbyung*/ gzhung srong pas dregs gsol/ bskyed rdzogs chung bar ma tshang ba rnams zab don nas kha bsabs te/ tshogs byin rlabs nas/ tshogs bsgral bstab zur byang sbyar/ bar bshags mthar/ gdangs bskang che chung gang rung sbyar/ tshogs drang ba las byang ltar/ lhag ma btang*/ dkar gtor rtsa rgyud/ chad brtan/ bro mnan/ dngos grub blang ba dor/ bshags pa/ brtan bzhugs bsdu ldang*/ bsngo smon/ bkra shis bcas/ drag sngags so lnga'i thun la zhugs/ gzhung chen nas stong tshig bya'o/ snga thun bzlas pa la sleb pa dang*/ gzhung srong ba lta bus tho gsos rgyal tho sgo byang bcas 'dzugs dus ltar bya ba'am yang na/ las byang lta stang gi mtshams bcad mgor/ sgrub khog gi rgyal tho bsdus pa sbyar/ dam sri mnan pa 159) sgyur chog rdo rje mtshams pas rgyas par sgrub khog gi dus bcu gnyis/ bsdus par dus bzhi gang rigs bya/ bskang gsol lta bus phyag bzhi'i gsol ka dang*/ mchod pa phud kong nyin rer lan re gtong dgos/ mtshan thun las byang dus gsum gtong lugs nyin thun gnyis pa dang 'dra/ thun pa so sos rin rnam rgyun khyer dang chags med rgyun khyer gang rigs btang nas thun gzung*/ stong tshig spyi ltar ro/ nyin gnyis pa la/ cha gsum tshab tu bgegs gtor gtong ba las gzhan 'dra/ bsnyen par sleb pa dang*/ bsnyen rgyun gyis zab don nam rin rnam rgyun khyer gang bde btang*/ nyin gsum pa la/ dzab dmigs dbang gi mdo byang gi nub dang po'i dmigs pa bskyur nas/ nub bar ma ye shes lha bsnyen ni/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer dkar po: gong gi grangs med pa= phyogs bcur 'phros pas: 'og gi dkyil 'khor= gnas par gyur: dzab bskul sogs nyin snga ma rnams ltar/ zhi tshe'i tshab tu bkra shis tshe yi sgrub pa'i/

bdag nyid che mchog he ru ka dbu nyi shu= lhang lhang gyur: bho dhi dang 160) tsaṇ+ḍa ste zhi khro sbrel ma'i gsham du/ a yu= sbyar ba bzla/ hūm̐:sku gsung thugs= bsnyen pa rnams gang skabs/ bla g.yu'i skor bskyur nas mthar dbyung*/ nyin bzhi pa dang lnga pa yang nyin gsum ba bzhin no/ nyin drug pa la/ dbang byang dzab dmigs tshab tu/ dbang byang nub tha ma gsum gyi mkha' las dngos grub blang ba/ bdag nyid che mchog= thim par gyur: dzab bskul sogs nyin snga ma rnams ltar/ tshe dzab+da zin nas dbang gi mdo byang 'phros/ sngags kyi 'od zer= zhu bar gyur: zhi drag sbrel ma brgya tsam bzla/ sgrub chen rkyang pa dbang dag mi 'brel skabs dbang byang bsnyen dmigs 'di rnams dor chog byin 'bebs 'phros su rgyun gyi dngos grub blang ba rata gling lugs ltar bya bar 'dod na/ dngos grub skul pa zab don gyi/

hūm̐: lha dang rig 'dzin= sid+dhi hūm̐: sman mchod/ chos sku kun bzang= sid+dhi pha la a la la ho: phyi thun sogs nyin snga ma rnams ltar/ nyin bdun pa/ byin 'bebs rjes su phyi chog gnyis snga tshar grub nas/ gzhung chen dang lhan cig dregs gsol/ las byang gi tshogs phrin gdab pa nas/ gzhung rgyug 'gro ba ma lus pa'i don byed par gyur cig tshogs mchod mthar/ 'gugs pa 161) bsgral las don brgyad ma'am/ bsdu na gzhung 'gros/ bskang zhing bshags par gyur: mdangs bskang chen mo/ las byang hūm̐ bdag cag ma rig= sogs nas/ rtsal du gsol: sid+dhi hūm̐ phaṭa: bar/ 'dir mchod pa phud skong btang*/ tshogs drang ba/ lhag ma/ zhig gling gi brda drug bskul pa btang yang chog bskul pa mi mngon ma/ chad tho rgyas pa/ brtan ma/ bro mnan/ rjes chog mchod bstod/ hūm̐: zhi khro kun 'dus= sogs bsdu rim/ lhan gyis bzhag skad cig la= lhag chad kha bskang*/ smon lam/ bkra shis/ cis kyang= a hūm̐: bar rgyal dkyil/ bkra shis/ bshags pa/ bsdu rim/ lus srung*/ sa mchog 'od gsal= ka thob shog: bzlas pa la 'jug mtshan thun sogs sngar ltar/ nyin tha ma'i mtshan thun las byang gsum pa dang lhan cig zab don skyabs sems nas drag sngags so lnga yan/ dngos grub len chog ni/ las byang gi bgegs bskrad/ hūm̐: bde gshegs 'dus pa'i= khro bo rol pa'i mtshams bcad/ hūm̐ḥ stong gsum stong gi= phaṭa: las byang byin 'bebs/ hūm̐: dus gsum bde gshegs= hūm̐ hūm̐: sgrub khog gi zhal zas thams cad= gnas par gyur: las byang gi 162) bdud rtsi byin brlab/ hūm̐ḥ bdud rtsi= hrīḥṭha: sgrub khog gi sngags rnams la/ sarba pañtsa= sbyar ba ci nus/ dkyil 'khor= gnad dbab/ bdag rigs so so'i= zhi ba'i lha tshogs= sngags bdun/ hūm̐ hūm̐: sogs/ bzhengs par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: zhes brjod pas rak+ta de dag bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs/ hūm̐: bcom ldan= gsal bas thob par gyur:

las byang sman mchod/ zhi ba la/ dbus mtha' med pa'i= sho lo ka sngags bcas/ 'og ma rnams la 'di'i 'gres so sor sbyar/ lhag ma'i nang du= sogs/ smon lam bcas/ yang*/ bdag che mchog tu gsal ba'i= gong gi gnad dbab dmigs pa nas gzhung gsal/ bka' srung sman mchod tshar nas las byang gi hūm̐:don dam thig le= sid+dhi hrī: sngags 'di bgrangs nas bum pa sogs sgrub rten kun gyi dbang len/ sgrub khog gi lha tshogs thams cad= rang bzhin du gyur: dngos grub rdzas dbang dbang chen skabs sbyor dgos pas dor la/ 'og gi bkra shis/ hūm̐: bcom ldan= smon lam/ a la la ho: bar/ de yan gyis sgrub chen dngos gzhi'i las rim tshar/ sgrub dbang 163) mdo byang chen mo ni/ bde gshegs rgyal ba sa khrus bya/ bgegs gtor/ las byang bka' bsgo/ hūm̐: bde gshegs 'dus pa'i= khro bo rol pa'i mtshams/ hūm̐: stong gsum stong gi= mtshon cha'i mtshams/ hūm̐: bde gshegs= gsang mtshams/ hūm̐: ma bcos= a ti: kun slong bcos nas/ mdo byang dbu nas/ a bhi ṣiñtsa rgya rgya rgya: mtshams sbyor bcas maṇ+ḍal phul/ gnang ba sbyin pa sta gon skabs ltar la/ rigs kyi bu khyod theg pa'i snod: sogs/ sgrubs shig: 'og gi de nas yul thun mong = skyabs sems sdom gzung bcas/ gsum du 'dus so: 'og gi 'jug pa dngos kyi skabs/ chas su 'jug pa ni= sogs/ rim par dur khrod chas dang*/ mig dar/ me tog byin/ sdom gzung bsdus pa rnams dor la/ dri thig ye shes dbab pa/ byin 'bebs las byang*/ hūm̐: dus gsum bde gshegs= btang*/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: ho: dkyil 'khor= sogs/ me tog dor/ ming gdags/ mig dbye/ lha ngo bstan/ dam tshig 'begs/ dmyal bar ltung: 'og gi de nas dbang dngos skur ba la'ang bzhi ste phyi dag= sogs/ sha ya a a: 164) phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis rjod/ lnga pa/ thun mong rig pa'i dbang lnga las rdzogs par nar 'don la re re bzhin/ bud+dha kā la= bum dbang bcu gnyis/

rgyal srid sna bdun bskur dgos/ bzhag pa yin no: gnyis pa nang dbang= sogs/ bka' sdod tshar nas/ lha'i snang ba dang ma bral ba'o: bar/ dbang chen mdo byang tshab tu/ pad+ma shel phug bskur na khrus bgegs bskrad srung 'khor/ maṇ+ḍal/ rnal 'byor rgyun dbang gi mig dar me tog nas bum dbang gsol 'debs yan grub mtshams/ pad+ma shel phug gi de la dang po zhi ba'i dbang rdzas= mi 'bral ba'o: bar btang bas 'thus/ de nas dngos grub rdzas dbang ni/ sgrub khog gi hūm̐: rang bzhin= bhan+dha lnga/ bum pa/ thal chen bdud rtsi/ g.yang gzhi/ byang sems/ rdor dril/ yungs dkar/ phur pa/ phreng ba/ sngags byang*/ tshe zan/ ral gri 'jam des mar/ zla rgyas zho/ gal phye sha tshil/ dza gad chang*/ zas sna tshogs/ zla gam/ 'dod yon lnga bcas/ shis brjod/ dam tshig khas blang*/ gtang rag maṇ+ḍal/ lus 'bul/ dge bsngo bcas byas nas slob ma gyes/ khrom 165) dbang chags med gtor dbang ngam rnal 'byor rgyun dbang gis bya/ de nas/ dregs gsol/ zab don/ tshogs byin rlabs nas/ lhag ma las byang gi bskul/ chad tho mthar/ gong gi skor/ brtan ma/ bro mnan/ dngos grub/ nongs bshags/ tshes bcu'i dus mchod lta bur zhag gis bcad na/ bsdu rim sogs bya tshes bcu gcig nyin/ 'di'i bar bsdus tsam btang*/ ras bris la brtan bzhugs/ rdul tshon la gshegs gsol/ bsdu rim/ sgrub khog gi go bsgo/ lus srung*/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid= oṃ āḥhūm̐ swa hā: bar/ sgrub khog gi gter sbas/ hūm̐: skyobs pa= dal bsdu/ hūm̐: dur khrod= hūm̐ hūm̐: bar/ ༈ rgyal tho/ sgo byang rnams 'dzugs dus ltar la/ phrin bcol tshab tu/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ rnal 'byor= sogs/ yig brgya dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra mu: zhes brjod/ khro bcu'i phur pa mas rim nas/ oṃ badz+ra kī la ya urkī la ya sarba kī li ya badz+ra dhā ra a dzñā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭaḥswa hā: tshar bcus rim par blang*/ oṃ ru ru phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha

166)sid+dhi lo tsa ni sarba ar+tha sa dha ni swa hā: phur rtse 'o mas bkru/ bgegs rnams kyang sos nas sangs rgyas par gyur/ skye med kyi don dran pas/ a ka ro'i sngags brjod nas rdul tshon bsdu/ rdul tshon med na thig shul dri bzang gis phyi/ tshes bcu'i skabs sogs tshe dbang bskur dgos na slar zhi tshe lta bu btang nas bskur bas 'thus/ dkyus la mi dgos/ ༈ sgrub khog gi smon lam/ ho: mi gnas ye shes= nongs bshags/ zhal skyems drangs nas gtong thun bcas/ mar me'i smon lam/ las byang gi bkra shis sogs shis pa rgyas par brjod pas legs par grub pa yin no/ rdul tshon chu bor skyel ba sogs gsang sngags spyi'i 'gros ltar shes par bya'o// rab zab rgyud dang sgrub sde'i chu klung kun// gcig bsdus sgrub chen bde gshegs 'dus pa zhes// mchog thun dbyig gi mdzod chen 'di bor nas// 'ching bu nor bur re nas rgyug gam ci// rgyud lung man ngag gzhan rnams nyams yang bla'i// bka' brgyad bskyed rdzogs man ngag nyams mi rung*// o rgyan chen po'i thugs dam lha skal mchog /'di la mi zhugs skal ldan su zhig yod// de slad gnad rnams dril ba'i sgrub 167) chen dang*// dbang rdzogs rgyas par bya ba'i lag len rnams/ tshad ldan dam pa mang pos gsal zin gyi// 'di ni sgrub chen bum dbang 'brel ma tsam// 'di dges 'gro kun kun bzang bde ba che// tshe 'dir 'grub nas phrin las rnam pa bzhis// ma rung bdud sde'i ru mtshon bsnyil nas kyang*// gsang chen bstan pa dar zhing rgyas gyur cig /zhes pa'ang mang thos blo gsal pad+ma dzñā nas yang yang bskul ba dang*/ rang gi 'dun pa bcas dmar ser can gyi lo'i dbang po zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi tshes nyer gcig bzang por sngags btsun dpal chen 'dus pa rtsal gyis bris pa dge legs 'phel// 168)
